target_customer: Biomedical researchers and biotech and pharma R&D teams that need tissue slides, staining and pathology analysis
problem: Preparing and analyzing histology slides was slow and manual, with long turnaround and no easy digital sharing of images.
business_model: Fee for service lab processing plus a cloud image platform (PathologyMap)
product_category: Automated histology lab services and digital pathology

founders.name: Ke Cheng
founders.background_notes: Titled Dr. Ke Cheng, Founder and CEO in the 2021 PR Newswire release; YC page lists only her.

technical_complexity.rationale: Combining wet lab automation, tracking and a whole slide image platform needed lab operations and software together, though each part was established technology.

defensibility.rationale: A growing preclinical pathology image database and lab throughput gave some advantage, but histology is a services business others can enter.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying by incumbents was found in sources reviewed.

market_need_then: No dated 2016 source on demand was found; the 2021 press release claims over 1,000 customers and delivery of digital slides in as little as 48 hours.

branding.domain_note: Uses histowiz.com, now redirecting to home.histowiz.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and professional, with taglines such as your goal is discovery, our goal is to get you there faster

branding.community_and_virality: A podcast interview with the founder and trade press; no merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: The name signals histology and a wizard-like ease, but no source supports a view that the brand itself drove sales in this niche; the word mark was registered in August 2021.

outcome_analysis: HistoWiz began in Brooklyn around 2012 to 2013, joined YC in Winter 2016 and raised a 32M Series A led by Vivo Capital in October 2021 to automate its lab and open a GLP lab in Miami. It remains independent and active with the company site and press in 2025 and 2026. Strength comes from lab automation and a large image database, while the timeline of earlier funding is unclear.
notes: Total raised is 33.7M per CB Insights over 6 rounds and 32.3M per VCBacked; earlier rounds beyond the Series A (including YC and ZhenFund per an aggregator) were seen only in aggregators and are not recorded. The release does not mention prior funding. YC page lists team size 2 and one founder. Founding year conflicts: 2012 in most sources, 2013 in one. Competitors left empty: no dated 2016 source naming rivals was found, and the PR release names none.
